claim.claim-text: a tub body (41) in which water is stored; a tub cover (43) forming an upper surface of the tub body (41); and a drum (5) rotatably provided in the tub body (41) to receive laundry, wherein the tub cover (43) comprises an upper surface, and a side surface (41b) extending from the upper surface toward the tub body (41) to form a circumference of the tub cover (43) and a portion of which is inserted into the tub body (41), and wherein a height of the tub body (41) is lower than a height of the drum (5).
2. The laundry treatment apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the side surface comprising:

an insertion part (441) inserted into the tub body (41) and in contact with an inner circumferential surface of the tub body (41); and an extension part (443) extending upwardly from one end of the insertion part (441) toward the upper surface.
3. The laundry treatment apparatus according to claim 2, wherein an outer circumferential diameter of the insertion part (441) is smaller than an inner circumferential diameter of the tub body (41).
4. The laundry treatment apparatus according to claim 2 or 3, wherein a length of the extension part (443) is longer than the length of the insertion part (441).

5. The laundry treatment apparatus according to any one of claims 2 to 4, wherein the side surface further comprises a curved part (447) disposed between one end of the extension part (443) and the upper surface and bent toward the inside of the tub body (41).

6. The laundry treatment apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the tub cover (43) further comprises a protruding part (442) protruding from the side surface in a radial direction and supported by the tub body (41),
7. The laundry treatment apparatus according to claim 6, wherein the tub cover (43) further comprises a bent part (444) bent downward from an end portion of the protruding part (42),

8. The laundry treatment apparatus according to claim 6 or 7, wherein the tub body (41) further comprises a support part (440) protruding from the tub body (41) in a radial direction to support the bent part (444),

9. The laundry treatment apparatus according to any one of claims 6 to 8, wherein the tub cover (43) further comprises a reinforcing rib protruding in a radial direction from the protruding part (42) and having a first fastening hole (446),

wherein a second fastening hole communicating with the first fastening hole (446) is provided on an upper side of the tub body (41), and wherein the tub cover (43) is fixed to the tub body (41) by a fixing member extending through the first fastening hole (446) and the second fastening hole.

10. The laundry treatment apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the tub cover (43) comprises an introduction hole (431) through which an inside of the tub body (41) communicates with an outside of the tub body (41), and a supply hole (433) through which water is supplied into the tub body (41).
